payout_quote: Once your DoorDash Crimson application is approved, you'll automatically receive payouts after every dash, at no fee, to your DoorDash Crimson account. Earnings deposits typically occur within seconds.
timing: Automatic payouts after every completed dash; deposits typically occur within seconds. Virtual card usable immediately on approval; physical card arrives in 7-10 business days.
eligibility: Active Dasher; apply in the Dasher app Earnings tab; successful ID verification required; no credit check; no fee to apply. Banking services via Starion Bank, Member FDIC.
steps: Open the Dasher app and go to the Earnings tab.
Tap the DoorDash Crimson entry point and follow the application instructions.
Complete ID verification (approval may take up to 3 business days if more information is needed).
Once approved, your payout method switches to Crimson automatically and earnings deposit after every dash.
Use the virtual card in the app or add it to Apple Wallet / Google Wallet / Samsung Wallet while the physical card ships.
catches: No per-payout fee. Out-of-network ATM withdrawals cost $2.50 each after 8 free in-network MoneyPass withdrawals per month; lost/damaged card replacement is $5.
Crimson cannot be combined with Fast Pay. Fast Pay ($1.99 per daily cashout) remains the alternative for dashers who stay on weekly direct deposit.
DasherDirect is a legacy program being sunset; do not sign up for it.
Pay varies by market and demand; fuel, maintenance, insurance, tolls and other vehicle costs reduce net earnings.
No delivery-count promotion is quoted on the official page.
biggest_catch: Crimson replaces Fast Pay entirely: once your Crimson application is approved you automatically receive after-dash payouts and can no longer use Fast Pay, so it is a commitment to the Crimson banking account, not an optional add-on.

who_pays: DoorDash pays your delivery earnings directly, and once your Crimson application is approved, every dash's pay auto-deposits into your DoorDash Crimson account at no fee. The Crimson account is a debit account from DoorDash, with banking services provided by Starion Bank, Member FDIC.
who_qualifies: You must be an active Dasher and pass the Crimson ID verification inside the Dasher app's Earnings tab - no credit check and no fee to apply. To dash at all, DoorDash requires you to be 18 or older (19 in several states, 21 in California), pass a free background check, and have a smartphone plus any car with a valid license and insurance (bikes and scooters work in select markets).
work_available: Work is demand-dependent: the official page states pay varies by market and demand, and it promises no minimum number of orders. Expect idle stretches in slow or saturated markets - nothing about your volume is guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid for deliveries you complete and confirm through the Dasher app; canceled or incomplete orders do not pay. DoorDash tracks acceptance and completion rates and says low completion can affect your access to orders, but the official cashout page publishes no exact rating threshold for withheld pay, so that part is unverified.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Crimson itself costs nothing: no application fee, no monthly fee, no credit check, and DoorDash's official page describes the background check as free. Your costs are the car itself: fuel, maintenance, insurance, and tolls all come out of your pocket, plus $2.50 for out-of-network ATM withdrawals after 8 free in-network ones per month and $5 for a replacement card. Time spent waiting for orders, driving between hotspots, and onboarding is unpaid - you only earn on completed dashes.
when_cash_arrives: After every completed dash, your full earnings auto-deposit to your Crimson account, at no fee, typically within seconds. Spend immediately with the in-app virtual card (also addable to Apple, Google, or Samsung Wallet) while the physical card ships in 7-10 business days. There is no daily cap or transfer count - it is automatic after each dash, and once approved you can no longer use Fast Pay ($1.99 per daily cashout, for non-Crimson dashers on weekly deposit).
